summary: karan finally fixed that pesky *waydroid-tray* link typo and made the live url test in `experiencecontent` stop being a joke. over at openresto, they turned it into a full-service restaurant api—added turn times by party size (finally!), hooked ‘em up in the locations form, and slapped booking statuses onto the api and admin screens like it’s nobody’s business. also seeded that walk-in waitlist into demo data, so now the demo’s got *real* chaos.
